summary: One high-severity coordinator issue was identified with a current-target location claim that Mulgae must verify.

findings.title: Fallback is triggered after a valid negative review
findings.description: The coordinator appears to treat a valid finding-bearing result as an execution failure, which discards a sound review and reports the role as failed.
findings.recommendation: Fail a role only for typed provider availability, execution, or invalid-output failures. Preserve valid negative reviews as successful role results.
